title: Identification and characterization of predictive and prognostic markers in neuroendocrine neoplasms
summary:
The aim of this research project is to investigate known biomarkers and new biomarkers for a specific type of cancer (neuroendocrine neoplasms) to determine whether the course of the disease can be predicted by measuring these biomarkers.
To this end, samples from patients who have already been treated for this cancer are examined and compared with the patients' follow-up data. The samples already collected are stored in the pathology archive. This is a retrospective analysis.
conditions: Malignant neoplasms, stated or presumed to be primary, of specified sites, except of lymphoid, haematopoietic and related tissue

interventions.name: Retrospective analysis of tissue and section preparations of neuroendocrine neoplasms routinely archived in pathology after completion of diagnostics, correlated with clinical follow-up data.
